summary: Ipolito Fenukitau is a Tongan rugby union footballer born 22 July 1972. He has played over 10 times for the Tonga national rugby union team. He represented Tonga at the 1995 Rugby World Cup in South Africa and the 2003 Rugby World Cup in Australia, and his usual position is flanker.
one_line: Tongan rugby union flanker who played over 10 Tests for Tonga, including at the 1995 and 2003 Rugby World Cups.
